SELECT ?z ?zoneLabel ?p ?pclass WHERE {
  ?z a brick:Zone .
  ?z rdfs:label ?zoneLabel .
  ?p brick:hasProperty ?z .
  ?p a ?pclass .
  FILTER(CONTAINS(?zoneLabel, "ZN_6"))
}

import csv
tid = "be41bf6b-c1ca-5cc0-a271-2cd4fca56654"
rows = []
with open(VALUES_CSV) as f:
    r = csv.DictReader(f)
    for x in r:
        if x['timeseries_id']==tid and x['timestamp'].startswith('2018-04-05'):
            rows.append((x['timestamp'], float(x['value'])))
rows.sort()
print(len(rows))
print(rows[:3], rows[-3:])
print("max", max(v for _,v in rows))
print("all<=29", all(v<=29 for _,v in rows))
print("any>29", [r for r in rows if r[1]>29])
print("any>29 incl >?", any(v>29 for _,v in rows))
